Basic web search request with a simple query

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.searchRequestFromJson("{\"model\":\"brave/web-search\",\"query\":\"What is Rust programming language?\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.search(req: _req)
print(result)
```
